Houston Drunk Driving Accident Lawyer (2025): Your Legal Guide After a DUI Crash

You’re driving home after dinner, the light turns green, and suddenly—bam. A car plows into you out of nowhere. The other driver stumbles out, smelling like alcohol.

It’s one of the most terrifying and infuriating situations imaginable—and sadly, it happens far too often in Houston. Every year, thousands of innocent Texans are injured or killed in drunk driving accidents.

If this happened to you or someone you love, you deserve answers, accountability, and compensation. A Houston drunk driving accident lawyer from The Lange Firm can help you get all three.

1. The Hard Truth About Drunk Driving in Houston

Houston consistently ranks among the top cities in the U.S. for drunk driving accidents. Wide highways, late-night bars, and long commutes create a dangerous mix.

According to the Texas Department of Transportation:

  • Over 25% of all traffic fatalities in Texas involve an intoxicated driver.

  • In Harris County alone, hundreds of DUI-related crashes occur every year.

  • Many of these accidents happen between midnight and 3 a.m., when roads should be safest.

The result? Families torn apart, victims facing lifelong injuries, and emotional trauma that doesn’t go away just because the criminal case ends.

That’s why hiring an experienced personal injury lawyer who understands both the legal and emotional fallout of these crashes is so important.

2. Criminal Case vs. Civil Lawsuit: What’s the Difference?

If the drunk driver was arrested, you might think justice will come automatically—but criminal justice and civil justice are not the same thing.

  • Criminal Case: The state prosecutes the drunk driver for violating the law (DWI). The goal is punishment—fines, jail time, license suspension.

  • Civil Case: You file a claim for damages against the driver (and possibly others). The goal is compensation for your injuries, losses, and suffering.

Even if the driver faces criminal charges, you won’t automatically receive compensation unless you take separate civil action.

That’s where The Lange Firm comes in—focusing on your recovery while prosecutors handle the criminal side.

3. What a Houston Drunk Driving Accident Lawyer Does for You

After a drunk driving crash, you’re dealing with chaos—medical bills, insurance calls, maybe even missed work. A skilled lawyer steps in to handle every legal aspect, so you can focus on healing.

Here’s what The Lange Firm does for clients:

  • Investigates the crash and gathers police reports, witness statements, and toxicology evidence.

  • Identifies all liable parties, including bars or restaurants that may have overserved the driver (under Texas’s Dram Shop Law).

  • Negotiates aggressively with insurance companies to get fair compensation.

  • Handles all communication with adjusters, defense attorneys, and opposing parties.

  • Represents you in court if necessary.

In short: The Lange Firm protects your rights and fights for every dollar you’re entitled to under Texas law.

4. Compensation You Can Recover After a Drunk Driving Accident

Drunk driving victims often suffer catastrophic injuries and long-term financial strain. Texas law allows you to recover several types of damages, including:

Economic Damages:

  • Medical bills (past and future)

  • Lost wages or loss of earning capacity

  • Vehicle damage

  • Rehabilitation and therapy costs

Non-Economic Damages:

  • Pain and suffering

  • Mental anguish

  • Emotional distress

  • Loss of enjoyment of life

  • Loss of companionship (for families of victims)

Punitive (Exemplary) Damages:

Because drunk driving involves reckless behavior, Texas courts often award punitive damages—extra compensation designed to punish the driver and deter similar conduct.

The Lange Firm pursues all available damages to make sure your recovery truly reflects what you’ve lost.

5. What If the Drunk Driver Doesn’t Have Insurance?

Unfortunately, many intoxicated drivers are also uninsured or underinsured. But that doesn’t mean you’re out of options.

You may still recover compensation through:

  • Your own uninsured/underinsured motorist (UM/UIM) coverage

  • Dram Shop claims against bars or restaurants that served the driver too much alcohol

  • Third-party liability claims (for example, if a company vehicle was involved)

The Lange Firm investigates every possible avenue to ensure victims aren’t left paying the price for someone else’s negligence.

6. Understanding Texas Dram Shop Law

Under the Texas Alcoholic Beverage Code §2.02, establishments can be held liable if they:

  1. Served alcohol to an obviously intoxicated person who presented a clear danger to themselves or others, and

  2. That person’s intoxication directly caused the accident.

So if a bar kept serving drinks to someone who could barely stand—and that person got behind the wheel—you can pursue a claim against that business.

These cases can be complex, but The Lange Firm knows how to trace evidence, gather video footage, and hold irresponsible establishments accountable.

7. How Long Do You Have to File a Drunk Driving Accident Claim in Texas?

The statute of limitations for personal injury claims in Texas is two years from the date of the crash.

That might sound like plenty of time, but evidence can disappear fast:

  • Witnesses forget details

  • Businesses delete security footage

  • Insurance companies delay and distract

Contacting a Houston drunk driving accident lawyer as soon as possible helps preserve your case and strengthens your position.

8. Common Injuries in Drunk Driving Accidents

Drunk driving accidents are often more severe than ordinary crashes because impaired drivers react slowly—or not at all. Common injuries include:

  • Traumatic brain injuries (TBI)

  • Spinal cord injuries and paralysis

  • Broken bones and fractures

  • Severe whiplash and back injuries

  • Internal bleeding

  • Wrongful death

The Lange Firm works closely with medical experts to document your injuries and calculate the full cost of recovery—not just immediate bills, but long-term care, therapy, and future needs.

9. How Much Does a Drunk Driving Accident Lawyer Cost?

Here’s the part most clients are relieved to hear:
At The Lange Firm, you pay nothing upfront.

The firm works on a contingency fee basis, which means:

  • You don’t pay hourly or out of pocket.

  • The firm only gets paid if you win.

  • Legal fees come from your settlement, not your wallet.

That ensures your lawyer is motivated to maximize your recovery—not just settle quickly.

10. What to Do Right After a Drunk Driving Accident

If you’re reading this soon after an accident, here’s what to do immediately:

  1. Call 911 – Get police on scene and make sure the driver is tested for intoxication.

  2. Get medical attention – Even if you feel “fine,” many injuries don’t show up right away.

  3. Take photos and videos – Document everything: vehicles, injuries, road conditions, license plates.

  4. Get witness info – Contact details for anyone who saw what happened.

  5. Avoid talking to insurance adjusters – They’re not your friend. Let your lawyer handle it.

  6. Contact The Lange Firm – The sooner you get legal help, the stronger your case will be.

11. Can You Sue for Wrongful Death After a Drunk Driving Crash?

Yes. If your spouse, child, or parent was killed in a drunk driving accident, you can file a wrongful death claim.

The Lange Firm helps grieving families pursue justice for:

  • Funeral and burial costs

  • Loss of income or benefits

  • Emotional suffering and loss of companionship

  • Punitive damages for reckless behavior

These cases are heartbreaking—but they also serve an important purpose: holding reckless drivers accountable so other families don’t suffer the same loss.

12. What Sets The Lange Firm Apart

Choosing the right attorney can make or break your case. Here’s what makes The Lange Firm stand out among Houston personal injury lawyers:

  • Personal attention: You’ll work directly with attorney Evan Lange, not just a paralegal or case manager.

  • Local experience: Based near Sugar Land, the firm understands Houston courts, judges, and insurers.

  • Proven results: The Lange Firm fights tirelessly for fair compensation, no matter how complex the case.

  • Transparent communication: No hidden fees. No empty promises. Just honest, strategic advocacy.

You’ve already been through enough. You deserve a lawyer who treats your case with care—and your pain with respect.

13. The Emotional Impact of Drunk Driving Accidents

The physical injuries are devastating enough—but many survivors face PTSD, anxiety, depression, and survivor’s guilt.

The Lange Firm understands that your recovery isn’t just medical—it’s emotional and financial, too. That’s why they work to ensure settlements include compensation for the full scope of what you’ve endured.

14. How The Lange Firm Builds a Strong Drunk Driving Case

Every drunk driving accident case is unique, but The Lange Firm follows a thorough process to maximize your recovery:

  1. Gathering Evidence: Police reports, blood alcohol results, camera footage, and witness statements.

  2. Reconstructing the Crash: Using experts to prove fault and impact severity.

  3. Assessing Damages: Calculating both financial and emotional losses.

  4. Filing Claims: Handling all negotiations with insurers.

  5. Litigation: Taking your case to trial if the insurer refuses to pay fairly.

From day one, the goal is clear: protect your rights and make sure the drunk driver—and anyone who enabled them—faces full accountability.

15. Take Action Today

Drunk driving accidents change lives in seconds. But your path to justice starts with one call.

If you or someone you love was injured by a drunk driver in Houston, The Lange Firm is ready to help you take control of your recovery. You don’t have to face insurance companies, paperwork, or legal deadlines alone.

Contact The Lange Firm’s Houston drunk driving accident lawyer today to schedule a consultation and learn your rights. Let us help you rebuild—with strength, dignity, and justice.

Final Takeaway

You didn’t choose to be hit by a drunk driver—but you can choose who stands beside you afterward.

The Lange Firm fights for victims of drunk driving accidents across Houston and Texas, helping them recover compensation, find closure, and move forward.

Justice isn’t automatic—but with the right lawyer, it’s absolutely possible.
